item.title: Inside Warwick’s Limited Edition Fortress 2026: Masterbuilt and Teambuilt Versions Revealed
item.description: Warwick reveals its Limited Edition Fortress 2026 bass at NAMM, available in Masterbuilt and Teambuilt versions with premium woods, MEC electronics, and Custom Shop craftsmanship.

item.title: Billy Bass Nelson, Founding Architect of P-Funk, Dies at 75
item.description: Billy Bass Nelson, founding bassist of Funkadelic and key architect of early P-Funk, has died at 75. His legacy helped reshape funk music.

item.title: New Mr. Big Video: Billy Sheehan Rips Through “Colorado Bulldog” at Sweetwater Studios
item.description: Billy Sheehan shines in a new Mr. Big live studio performance from Sweetwater Studios playing Colorado Bulldog and The Price You Gotta Pay.

item.title: Weekly Top Ten: Cliff Burton’s New Bass, Fretless Wonders, and NAMM Grooves
item.description: Catch up on No Treble’s most-read stories from Jan 24–30, 2026, including standout NAMM gear, a new Cliff Burton bass, fretless innovations, and unforgettable performances.

item.title: Nathan East’s First Signature Preamp Arrives: The Laney Digbeth DB-EAST-PRE
item.description: Nathan East teams up with Laney again for his first signature preamp, the Digbeth DB-EAST-PRE, featuring FET and Tube channels, LA-IR, and more.

item.title: Watch Jack Bruce Lead Cream Through “White Room” at Royal Albert Hall in Newly Released 2005 Video
item.description: Cream’s original lineup reunites at Royal Albert Hall in this newly released 2005 performance of White Room, led by Jack Bruce on fretless bass.

item.title: Inside Sadilah Guitars’ Rovid Fretless: A Desert-Inspired Short-Scale Bass from NAMM 2026
item.description: A chance NAMM encounter led us to Sadilah Guitars and their Rovid Fretless bass, a short-scale, desert-inspired build with earthy tone and unique design.

item.title: Fodera and Trickfish Unveil Preamp & Practice Amp Pedal for Studio-Grade Bass Tone Anywhere
item.description: Fodera and Trickfish have teamed up on a new Preamp & Practice Amp pedal, delivering Fodera-inspired tone shaping, flexible EQ, DI, and headphone practice features.

item.title: “War Pigs” at the Grammys: Post Malone, Slash, and Duff McKagan Celebrate Ozzy Osbourne’s Legacy
item.description: An all-star group paid tribute to Ozzy Osbourne at the Grammys, keeping it heavy and respectful on Black Sabbath’s “War Pigs.”

item.title: Spector Expands Signature Line at NAMM 2026 with New Doug Wimbish and Frank Bello Finishes
item.description: Spector debuted new finishes for its Doug Wimbish Euro 4 and Frank Bello NC-4 signature basses at NAMM 2026, including Aged White and Black Sapphire options.
